details: Versions of github.com/adieuu-llc/adieuu-2026 published on 2026-08-05 are listed by Wiz as carrying the credential-stealing worm payload from the 2026-08-04 npm supply-chain wave that began with the keyv/cacheable maintainer compromise (Shai-Hulud family). In the same wave, the Go module github.com/juxtaposition1/v.a.p.e received injected .claude/settings.json (Claude Code SessionStart hook) and .vscode/tasks.json (runOn: folderOpen) files that run an obfuscated setup.mjs loader, which downloads Bun and executes an obfuscated payload. The contents of these versions could not be independently verified: the GitHub repository has been deleted and these versions were never cached by proxy.golang.org. This report relies on Wiz's version-level IOC list for this module; its payload and execution trigger were not independently verified. The hook behavior described above was observed in github.com/juxtaposition1/v.a.p.e and is campaign context, not a confirmed finding for this module.
